scope: Captured from an isolated owned C-Gate 3.4 daemon whose only network is a disposable project on the ephemeral Toolkit PCI simulator; synthetic monitor-mode SAL lines were written on that loopback connection. No site project, access-control hardware, Docker service, or live C-Bus network was used. Project names are replaced by PROJECT and timestamps by <timestamp>. The first injected SAL also produced the native lazy-creation row '702 //PROJECT/254/213 - [accesscontrol] loaded application', which is omitted from the per-case rows.

decoder.short_opcode: bit 7 clear: command = bits 3..6, parameter length = bits 0..2; commands 0 close_access_point, 1 lock_access_point, 2 access_point_left_open, 3 access_point_forced_open, 4 access_point_closed, 6 exit_request; parameters zone, point
decoder.long_opcode: bit 7 set: command = bits 5..6, parameter length = bits 0..4; commands 1 access_request_valid, 2 access_request_invalid; parameters zone, point, direction, then requester = remaining parameter bytes as upper-case hex
decoder.event_row: 702 <application address> - [accesscontrol] <name> zone=Z point=P[ direction=D requester=HEX] sourceUnit=N
decoder.status_row: [# ]accesscontrol <name> <application address> <values> #sourceunit=N OID=; the '# ' prefix marks observations other than close/lock

cmqttd_event_layout: cmqttd emits the native timestamped level-8 702 event row and the '[# ]accesscontrol' status row for every case marked same; see native_cgate_specialist_events.json for the shared application-event shape

cases.label: request_valid
native_event_rows: #e# <timestamp> 702 //PROJECT/254/213 - [accesscontrol] access_request_valid zone=7 point=9 direction=1 requester=12AB00 sourceUnit=6

cases.label: request_invalid_empty
native_event_rows: #e# <timestamp> 702 //PROJECT/254/213 - [accesscontrol] access_request_invalid zone=7 point=9 direction=2 requester= sourceUnit=6

cases.label: concatenated
native_event_rows: #e# <timestamp> 702 //PROJECT/254/213 - [accesscontrol] access_request_valid zone=7 point=8 direction=1 requester=AA sourceUnit=7

cases.label: close_three_bytes
cases.note: native ignores the third parameter byte of short opcode 0x03; cmqttd rejects non-canonical short lengths and emits nothing

cases.label: zone_255
native_event_rows: #e# <timestamp> 824 //PROJECT/254/213 - bad SAL parameter: 02FF0915 - Zone out of range
cases.note: native reports only a code-824 diagnostic; cmqttd decodes nothing and emits no event

cases.label: point_255
native_event_rows: #e# <timestamp> 824 //PROJECT/254/213 - bad SAL parameter: 0207FF17 - Access Point out of range
cases.note: native reports only a code-824 diagnostic; cmqttd decodes nothing and emits no event

cases.label: direction_3
native_event_rows: #e# <timestamp> 824 //PROJECT/254/213 - bad SAL parameter: A307090369 - Direction out of range
cases.note: native reports only a code-824 diagnostic; cmqttd decodes nothing and emits no event

cases.label: request_too_short
native_event_rows: #e# <timestamp> 824 //PROJECT/254/213 - bad SAL parameter: A207096D - Direction not available
cases.note: native reports only a code-824 diagnostic; cmqttd decodes nothing and emits no event

cases.label: unknown_short_5
cases.note: native reports only a code-824 diagnostic; cmqttd decodes nothing and emits no event

cases.label: unknown_long_0
cases.note: native reports only a code-824 diagnostic; cmqttd decodes nothing and emits no event

cases.label: unknown_long_3
cases.note: native reports only a code-824 diagnostic; cmqttd decodes nothing and emits no event

cases.label: truncated
cases.note: native reports only a code-824 diagnostic; cmqttd decodes nothing and emits no event

cases.label: range_then_valid
native_event_rows: #e# <timestamp> 824 //PROJECT/254/213 - bad SAL parameter: 02FF09220304EC - Zone out of range
cases.note: native skips the out-of-range first message and still emits the second; cmqttd rejects the whole SAL and emits nothing

cases.label: trailing_byte
cases.note: native emits the complete first message before rejecting the truncated trailing opcode; cmqttd rejects the whole SAL and emits nothing
